description: Add and remove a domain from the list of permissive domains.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: The domain that is added or removed from the list of permissive domains.

parameters.name: no_reload
parameters.description: Disable reloading of the SELinux policy after making change to a domain’s permissive setting. The default is false, which causes policy to be reloaded when a domain changes state. Reloading the policy does not work on older versions of the policycoreutils-python library, for example in EL 6.”. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: permissive
parameters.description: Indicate if the domain should or should not be set as permissive. Choices: false true

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: Name of the SELinux policy store to use. Default: ""

examples:
- name: Change the httpd_t domain to permissive
  community.general.selinux_permissive:
    name: httpd_t
    permissive: true
